# v9 normalizer replays

These capture the unmodified Planner outline and the first observed finding for
ten v9 Config B failures. Support retains its complete Designer blueprint.
The other failed Designer reply bodies were unavailable after the disposable
profiles were removed. Replays reconstruct the reported missing control,
missing trigger example or duplicate declaration on the captured outline.
The Account Desk capture reproduces the lost diagnostic with an injected
field choice. It does not identify the original missing choice.
